raw_text:
I dumped thousands of photos across from my old phone.
They got filed under the date they were transferred.
I wanted (9 months later) to find a photo taken on that same date on the new phone.
It took about 5 hours, including looking for help online, where I encountered many others also complaining about the quality of the search feature. 
“Cat” works
“Two faces” yielded nothing
“Black and White” doesn’t work
“Face” yielded one face, although I have thousands
In the age of AI it should be possible to describe a photo and have it located.
